sources.title: docs: add flat config default to v9 migration guide
sources.excerpt: In case you still need to use the deprecated eslintrc config format, set environment variable `ESLINT_USE_FLAT_CONFIG` to `false`.
sources.applicability: ESLint v9 only; legacy explicitly deprecated; not valid for v10.

sources.title: feat!: remove eslintrc support
sources.excerpt:
ESLint v9 introduced a [new default configuration format](./configure/configuration-files) based on the `eslint.config.js` file. The [old format](./configure/configuration-files-deprecated), which used `.eslintrc` or `.eslintrc.json`, could still be enabled in v9 by setting the `ESLINT_USE_FLAT_CONFIG` environment variable to `false`.

Starting with ESLint v10, the old configuration format is no longer supported.
sources.applicability: ESLint v10 and later documented scope; consumer fixture pinned exactly 10.0.0.
